verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only client SDKs for Web, iOS and Android, plus REST room management, status-callback webhooks and real-time transcription. Nothing shows a server-side participant that can subscribe to live audio and publish synthesized speech back into a room. PSTN dial-in/out via Twilio Voice and one-way transcription are adjacent features of other products or capabilities, not a server-side agent participant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime
